## Goal
- Provide Rork-verifiable evidence and a newly built APK whose source is proven to match verified production.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do not claim emulator QA, publication, deployment, production parity, or production-ready APK status without recorded successful evidence.
- Do not deploy application changes unless Android release build and emulator/Maestro QA pass.
- APK signed with debug credentials must not be represented as Play Store/production-signing ready.
- Preserve owner authentication, source-mutation, Git push, deployment, emergency-stop, testing, and production-verification gates.

## Progress
### Done
- Corrected Playwright/Bun test-runner separation:
  - Renamed `expo/__tests__/e2e/ivx-owner-ai-smoke.spec.ts` to `expo/__tests__/e2e/ivx-owner-ai-smoke.e2e.ts`.
  - Added `expo/playwright.config.ts`:
    ```ts
    testDir: './__tests__/e2e',
    testMatch: '**/*.e2e.ts',
    baseURL: 'https://ivxholding.com',
    ```
  - Verified E2E discovery:
    ```bash
    cd expo && bunx playwright test --list
    ```
    ```text
    Total: 3 tests in 1 file
    ```
- Source changes were committed by Rork:
  ```text
  c57a0ff4cafa2c74f6748acf9dd267c3ff4b6be0
  Fixed issues with the automated testing system and updated the mobile application to the latest version.
  ```
- Local Git and remote were observed aligned:
  ```text
  branch: main
  HEAD: c57a0ff4cafa2c74f6748acf9dd267c3ff4b6be0
  origin/main: c57a0ff4cafa2c74f6748acf9dd267c3ff4b6be0
  ```
- TypeScript validation passed:
  ```bash
  bun x tsc --noEmit
  ```
  ```text
  exitCode: 0
  ```
- Public production checks passed:
  ```text
  https://ivxholding.com HTTP 200
  https://api.ivxholding.com/health status: healthy
  /api/public/chat HTTP 200
  ```
- Public deterministic IVX IA response succeeded:

    "ok": true,

  workflow_dispatch accepted

- GitHub Actions run was created:

  run: 30748881196

  head_sha: 362e7f5e4699ff8c013367901909f27a33857fa5

  path: expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk

- Previously fixed stale active-job handling in `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` with `lastHeartbeatAt` tracking and activity-based stale evaluation.

### In Progress
- Monitor GitHub Actions run `30748881196` for completed release-build, emulator installation, launch, Maestro, screenshot, logcat, and artifact evidence.
- Obtain production source corresponding to commit `362e7f5e4699ff8c013367901909f27a33857fa5`, then build a fresh APK from that exact source.
- Run browser-rendered Playwright landing-page smoke once Chromium can run in this environment.
- Retain untruncated final results for Expo and backend unit suites.
- Verify source/deployment parity after any deployment.

### Blocked
- GitHub Android QA workflow has not completed:
  ```text
  status: in_progress
  conclusion: null
  updated_at: 2026-08-02T12:56:41Z
  ```
- No workflow artifacts were returned yet from run `30748881196`.
- Production is not at current Rork-published `main`:
  ```text
  production /health commit: 362e7f5e4699ff8c013367901909f27a33857fa5
  local/origin main: c57a0ff4cafa2c74f6748acf9dd267c3ff4b6be0
  ```
- The production commit object is not present locally:
  ```text
  fatal: bad object 362e7f5e4699ff8c013367901909f27a33857fa5
  ```
- Existing APK predates the Rork commit and has no recorded proof that it was built from production commit `362e7f5e…`; it cannot be called a verified-new-production APK.
- Current APK uses a debug signer:
  ```text
  CN=Android Debug
  ```
  It is not production-store-ready.
- Local Playwright browser test is not passing. Initial failure:
  ```text
  Error: browserType.launch: Executable doesn't exist
  ```
  Chromium was installed, but rerun failed:
  ```text
  Error: browserType.launch: Target page, context or browser has been closed
  ```
  API-only E2E checks passed; rendered landing-page evidence remains missing.
- Protected owner endpoints remain inaccessible with available credentials:
  ```text
  /api/ivx/agent-audit/overview HTTP 401
  /api/ivx/autonomous/runs/summary HTTP 401
  /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/status HTTP 401
  ```
- Provider proof remains incomplete:
  ```text
  provider: vercel_ai_gateway
  providerState: PROVIDER_VALIDATING
  lastHttpStatus: null
  ```
  The public chat success used `source: fallback`, not the configured primary provider.
- No local Android device is attached.

## Key Decisions
- Treat Rork commit `c57a0ff4…` as published source evidence, but do not equate it with deployed production because `/health` reports `362e7f5e…`.
- Keep Playwright E2E files on the `*.e2e.ts` pattern and use `expo/playwright.config.ts` to prevent Bun unit-test discovery conflicts.
- Do not provide the existing `app-release.apk` as a verified new-production APK: its build/source provenance does not match production and it is debug signed.
- Do not label GitHub Android QA passed until run `30748881196` has a successful conclusion and downloadable artifacts/logs.
- Keep architecture claims truthful: 12 role records remain `SHARED_WORKER_WITH_ROLE` until isolated runtimes and evidence exist.

## Next Steps
1. Poll GitHub run `30748881196` and job `91499226677` until terminal; download and inspect release APK, Maestro, screenshot, logcat, JUnit, and workflow logs.
2. Fetch/checkout production commit `362e7f5e4699ff8c013367901909f27a33857fa5` through an authorized repository path; verify its tree and source provenance.
3. Build a new APK from that exact commit with recorded build command, package metadata, SHA-256, signer, and embedded `sourceCommitSha`.
4. Install that fresh APK on an emulator/device; run launch, Maestro, logcat, screenshot, and release-flow checks.
5. Resolve the Chromium runtime closure and rerun:
   ```bash
   cd expo && bunx playwright test --reporter=line
   ```
6. Re-run and retain final summaries:
   ```bash
   cd expo && bun test --reporter dots
   bun test backend/ --reporter dots
   bun x tsc --noEmit
   ```
7. Obtain owner authentication for protected audit/worker endpoints and Render deployment authorization/evidence.
8. Only after all gates pass, deploy intended source, verify `/health` commit parity, and provide the resulting APK with its exact evidence.
9. Replace debug signing with an owner-controlled production keystore before external distribution.

## Critical Context
- User requests “Rork verified” evidence and a new APK verified against new production; this is not yet supportable because production/source/APK SHA parity is unresolved.
- Production health currently reports:
  ```json
  {
    "status": "healthy",
    "commit": "362e7f5e4699ff8c013367901909f27a33857fa5",
    "bootTime": "2026-08-02T11:23:59.380Z",
    "environment": "production",
    "version": "ivx-owner-ai-backend-v2026.07.26"
  }
  ```
- `expo/app.config.ts` derives `extra.sourceCommitSha` at build time:
  ```ts
  _sourceCommitSha = execSync('git rev-parse HEAD', { encoding: 'utf-8' }).trim();
  ```
  A newly built APK must be built from the production commit to embed matching source provenance.
- Existing APK timestamp:
  ```text
  2026-08-02 12:46:52.801157847 +0000
  ```
  Rork committed `c57a0ff4…` at:
  ```text
  Sun Aug 2 12:57:42 2026 +0000
  ```
  Therefore the current APK cannot have been built from that Rork commit.
- Android QA workflow production configuration:
  ```yaml
  EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: https://api.ivxholding.com
  NODE_ENV: production
  EXPO_PUBLIC_QA_BUILD: 'true'
  ```
- Public production IA result is fallback-only evidence:
  ```text
  source: fallback
  model: ivx-ia-conversation-brain
  ```
- Do not include incidental changes in release commits:
  ```text
  .rork/history/main/*.json
  expo/test-results/
  expo/playwright-report/
  ivx-holdings-platform
  ```

- `expo/playwright.config.ts`: newly added explicit Playwright E2E configuration and `*.e2e.ts` test matching.
- `expo/__tests__/e2e/ivx-owner-ai-smoke.e2e.ts`: production landing-page, health, and public-chat Playwright smoke tests.
- `expo/__tests__/e2e/ivx-owner-ai-smoke.spec.ts`: removed old Playwright filename that conflicted with Bun discovery.
- `expo/app.config.ts`: app version configuration and dynamically embedded `sourceCommitSha`.
- `expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk`: existing v1.9.3/code 91 debug-signed APK; not verified against current production.
- `expo/android/app/build.gradle`: Android release build/signing configuration.
- `expo/android/app/debug.keystore`: debug signing credential currently used for release APK output.
- `.github/workflows/android-emulator-qa.yml`: Android release APK, emulator, Maestro, diagnostics, and artifact workflow.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: single-flight durable worker, heartbeat/staleness handling, and owner-approved execution behavior.
- `backend/services/ivx-agent-registry.ts`: truthful runtime registry and shared-worker classification.
- `backend/api/ivx-agent-audit.ts`: protected owner audit surface.
- `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: protected owner/internal worker controls.
- `backend/hono.ts`: production health/version/readiness and scheduler boot logic.

responseMessageContents.text:
You’re right to ask. The run wasn’t still building—it **failed after 7m 44s**.

The build itself compiled nearly everything, then failed only when packaging because the CI copy of `debug.keystore` is malformed:

```text
Failed to read key androiddebugkey …
DerInputStream.getLength(): lengthTag=63, too big
```

So it never reached emulator install/QA. Normal builds take about **2–8 minutes** here; this one spent that time compiling 423 Android tasks before discovering the bad signing file at the end.

I’ll replace the broken CI debug signing setup and rerun it.
